star-main-recovery-verify.service:
[Unit]
Description=Restore and verify STAR backup checksums and databases

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 %h/.local/share/star-recovery/bin/recovery_backup.py --config %h/.config/star-recovery/star-main.json verify
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 %h/.local/share/star-recovery/bin/recovery_backup.py --config %h/.config/star-recovery/star-main.json baseline
TimeoutStartSec=30min
KillMode=control-group
UMask=0077
Nice=15
CPUWeight=20
IOWeight=20
NoNewPrivileges=yes
star-main-recovery-verify.timer:
[Unit]
Description=Daily full STAR backup restore check

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 07:45:00 UTC
Persistent=true
RandomizedDelaySec=60s
AccuracySec=30s

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
star-main-recovery-retention.service:
[Unit]
Description=Compact rolling STAR backups while preserving the separate baseline

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 %h/.local/share/star-recovery/bin/recovery_backup.py --config %h/.config/star-recovery/star-main.json retention
TimeoutStartSec=30min
KillMode=control-group
UMask=0077
Nice=15
CPUWeight=20
IOWeight=20
NoNewPrivileges=yes
star-main-recovery-retention.timer:
[Unit]
Description=Daily STAR backup retention

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 00:50:00 UTC
Persistent=true
RandomizedDelaySec=60s
AccuracySec=30s

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
